resources.string: Your command center: speaker, Google, music and AI in one place.
Speak through your Google Home speaker
Sign in with Google and read your sheets
A morning routine that announces today\'s birthdays
ISSASPEAKER joins your Google Home speaker, your Google account, your music and AI models that run on your own keys, so services that never talk to each other can share one routine.

There is no ISSASPEAKER server. Your keys, tokens and history stay on this phone, encrypted, and are left out of backups. Each permission is requested only when the feature that needs it is first used.
English, Spanish (Latin America) and Portuguese (Brazil). Change it in Settings.
All the code is public, under the MIT license.
Found a vulnerability? Please report it privately, never in a public issue.
No findings recorded. Each finding gets an ID (ISP-SEC-NNN) in docs/security/AUDIT-LOG.md.
The admin screens are a convenience gate, not a security boundary: they only show what the public repository shows.
Feature titles are available in English and Spanish.

resources.string: Each time you open the app or come back to it, titles, headings, text and labels each get a different high-legibility Google Font, drawn at random from a pool of %1$d. Rotating the screen keeps them.
